description:
Rooney Auctioneers are pleased to present this attractive 4 bedroom semi detached home located in the sought after area of Springfield drive in  Dooradoyle. No.8 Springfield Drive consists of a entrance hall, livingroom with fireplace, sitting room with gas fire and patio doors, kitchen tiled floor, dining room with rear door, utility room,  hallway with wet room WC, downstairs bedroom/ office. Upstairs consists of the main bathroom and three bedrooms, Stira / folding ladder installed. To the rear there is an enclosed garden. The rear mature garden has a sunny south aspect and with a stone patio area. To the front, the property is accessed by a driveway with gates. The property has double glazed windows and is heated by gas fired central heating system. 
Superbly located being close to all local amenities such as Crescent Shopping Centre, University Hospital Limerick, Raheen Business Park, Mungret Park, national & secondary schools and the M7/M20 motorways via the Shannon tunnel and the N18. Dooradoyle is situated in the suburbs of Limerick city approx. 3km from Limerick city. This property offers an abundance of appeal and potential in a great location, contact Peter Kearney at Rooney's for further information.
